workflows.title: TLE from GMAT
requirements: TLE Tailor and its Python dependencies
separate legacy GMAT API and compatible Python kernel
original mission inputs; source-only scientific kernels where used
workflows.input_notes: Requires a separately configured compatible GMAT Python API and the original GMAT mission/data inputs. Standalone gmatpy does not substitute for load_gmat in this historical script. Supply the source-only solar-system BSP with --ephemeris /path/to/kernel.bsp or TLE_TAILOR_EPHEMERIS.
original_differences: Retained as an explicitly historical entrypoint requiring the legacy API. Missing legacy API prerequisites now produce an explicit CLI error before propagation; no native success is claimed without that dependency.
Original native-session, matching, and exploratory notebook cells remain preserved; this companion runs only the named historical script.
The old script docstring named a nonexistent Test TLE from GMAT notebook; the actual preserved source is TLE from GMAT.ipynb.

workflows.original_notebook: tle_tailor/examples/notebooks/gps_examples/TLEFit - EQN - GPS - GPS Sat - No BSTAR.ipynb
requirements: TLE Tailor and its Python dependencies
source ephemeris or user-owned equivalent
optional Space-Track credentials for live comparison
workflows.input_notes: Requires original-checkout ephemeris fixtures under tle_tailor/data/ephemeris: gpsd6n22short.fth. These historical datasets are not shipped in the distribution. Set TLE_TAILOR_DATA_DIR to an external data directory preserving ephemeris/<filename>, with the original fixtures or equivalent user-owned inputs, before running installed copies. The maintained GPS no-Bstar script accepts --ephemeris /path/to/input.fth.
original_differences: The maintained script uses the shared fixed-BSTAR solver; the original inline state_size=7 experiment remains preserved source history.

The approximately 130 m in-sample fit is accepted for this example. The approximately 18.8 km hold-out error after 53 days is separate and has not been accepted. Inspect physical residuals alongside the unchanged historical solver stopping flag.
